The '''Lhosa system''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that shared its name with the [[Lhosan Industries]] corporation.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|252|Lhosan Industries}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lhosa system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
